scope: Three bounded candidates: ManagedSafariView browser-policy/error parent; native Safari creation/load callbacks; OpenURL modifier presentation owner. Static artifact plus current local WK source review only.

official_observations.conclusion: Official browser parent permits ManagedSafariView or a supplied custom AnyView builder. Native Safari creation remains SFSafariViewController with barCollapsingEnabled=false, optional supplied tint/configure callback and modal style raw3.
official_observations.limit: Original Remote link→presentation policy assignment remains unknown. Presence of custom builder is not proof the existing independent WK local page matches it.

official_observations.conclusion: ManagedSafariView adds policy/URL admission and a native unavailable-content branch around Safari. It is not merely a Safari representable.
official_observations.limit: Predicate helper returns raw/discriminated values not completely named. Do not call this generic network-loading-failure UI, or equate source no-policy/denied branch to current offline serviceUnavailable.

official_observations.conclusion: Original unavailable branch has a label/image, description and a capsule-styled Close action. Exact title and icon can be recovered.
official_observations.limit: Description factory0x75d5984 is not fully interpreted; exact policy reason text and Close owner action body0x62ca444 remain unknown. No dimensions or generic retry control inferred from this branch.

official_observations.conclusion: ManagedSafariView supplies separate configure and initial-load callbacks to SafariView. The initial-load completion forwards a Bool to its captured load tracker, distinct from WK navigation chrome.
official_observations.limit: LoadTracker field names alone do not establish failure presentation/retry. Complete success/false/cancellation/timeout semantics and all delegate callbacks are not reconstructed.

official_observations.conclusion: The common OpenURL modifier owns separate sheet/fullscreen URL state, scene changes, inherited custom builders, in-app browser presentation, policy alert queue and routing lifecycle. Its concrete body constructs environment transforms and observation hooks.
official_observations.limit: Body prefix inspected0x62a224c..0x62a35a0 only; generic tree has unresolved opaque context nodes. Metadata state names do not prove which presentation branch Remote selects. Do not label current single .sheet as recovered full original presentation.

implemented: Local custom-scheme resource provider selected only by explicit browser-preview-fixture and allowlisted example.invalid path.
Nonpersistent WK store with page JavaScript disabled; URL provider/mainframe admission blocks unapproved navigation.
WKNavigation identity rejects stale didFinish/didFail callbacks; close stops loading; unconnected resource capability shows explicit service-unavailable state.
SwiftUI .sheet and UINavigationController are host presentation choices.
source_differences: Original proved native carrier is SFSafariViewController; current WK layout/chrome is not direct recovery.
Original ManagedSafari policy unavailable UI has triangle label/description/Close; current generic resource-unavailable/loading-failure status does not represent policy-specific admission.
Original owner has distinct policyURL/url, optional custombuilder, sheet/fullscreen choices, routing and load-tracker callbacks; current request has id/url and a local provider only.
current_host_review.not_an_automatic_bug: These differences are declared service/policy/host boundaries. Existing local WK exercises offline frontend navigation. Without Remote route/policy capability, no source-backed instruction says to replace all URLs with Safari or add a policy-blocked failure for all offline links.

implementation_decision.reason: No bounded evidence closes the missing Remote route→effectivebrowserpolicy→presentation provider. Preserve current explicitly independent WK local adapter. Do not turn native type existence into universal dispatch.
implementation_decision.minimum_future_contract: A future provider must separately supply original requested URL/policy URL, route policy decision and optional custom browser builder; native Safari can then use observed barCollapse/tint/configure carrier. Policy denial must remain distinct from missing resource capability, network failure and cancellation. Native load tracking is a separate owner contract; do not derive completion from window opening.
implementation_decision.unsupported_ui: Until that owner exists, current returnable service-unavailable state remains appropriate adapter behavior, with no claim of original policy/error parity.
